responsibility: Declares the RVV `function_shape` objects that describe naming, typing, and checking strategies for vector intrinsic families. It is the interface header that exports the `shapes::` namespace used when building builtin groups, separating those declarations from the implementations in riscv-vector-builtins-shapes.cc.
same_name_distinction: Within the `riscv-vector-builtins-shapes` pair, this header merely declares the exported `shapes::` `function_shape` objects such as `loadstore`, `alu`, `vset`, and `vlenb`. Unlike `riscv-vector-builtins-shapes.cc`, it does not implement naming rules, instance construction, or semantic checks.
